part.text: Confirmed pre-existing (fails on unmodified tree due to current year being 2026 in the environment). The full run earlier showed no test failures — only the phpstan phar fatal after completion. Final sanity check on the issue scenario with `addUnitNoOverflow` too:

Fixed. The bug was in `mutateIfMutable` (src/Carbon/Traits/Date.php:3229), introduced as part of the `setUnitNoOverflow` optimization: when the instance was immutable it returned `$this` (the overflowing date) instead of the passed clamped boundary `$date`. So `Carbon::parse('2024-02-29')->toImmutable()->setUnitNoOverFlow('day', 31, 'month')` leaked `2024-03-02` instead of clamping to `2024-02-29 23:59:59.999999`.

Validation:
- Issue case and `addUnitNoOverflow` immutable/mutable cases now behave identically and correctly.
- Setters tests: 107 tests OK.
- Full suite (carbon, immutable, interval, period, timezone, localization): 5611 tests, only 1 failure in `CreateTest::testStartAndEndFallback`, verified pre-existing on the unmodified tree (environment-date dependent, year 2026 vs hardcoded 2024).
